note: Where each fork keeps its patches, and what each canonical patch is called there.
`workshop sync` GENERATES these files (D2, sync model (d)). The forks stay self-contained and
offline-buildable — no build-time network, no submodule — and drift becomes a red build in THIS repo
rather than an invisible difference between two repositories nobody diffs.
The filename map is explicit rather than derived. The Android fork numbers its patches 002/003/004/006
where the workshop numbers the same patches 001/002/003/004: the fork's numbering carries its APPLY
ORDER (patch.sh globs `patches/mpv/*`), so renumbering the files to match the workshop would be a
rename of every file for no gain and a real risk of reordering the series. The relative order is
identical either way, which is what actually matters. The darwin fork uses kebab-case names with no
ordering signal at all, because its order lives in the nix derivation.
`localPath` is resolved in this order: --<fork>-path, then $WORKSHOP_FORK_<FORK>, then the default
below, which assumes the forks are checked out beside this repo.

appliedBy.default: buildscripts/patch.sh — globs `patches/mpv/*` in filename order and applies each with `git apply` (no fuzz by construction). The tree is `git reset --hard` + `git clean -fdq` first, so re-runs are safe.
the dependency's nix derivation, `patch -p1` in source order inside `patchedSource`

byDep.mpv: nix/packages/mk-pkg-mpv/default.nix — `patch -p1` in source order inside `patchedSource`. Only the prefetch-hook line passes --fuzz=0 today; the rest still run at GNU patch's default fuzz 2 (tracked in rn-media task #32).
byDep.ffmpeg: nix/packages/mk-pkg-ffmpeg/default.nix — `patch -p1`, gated on the VIDEO variant only.
byDep.libxml2: nix/packages/mk-pkg-libxml2/default.nix — `patch -p1` on the dependency's own ltmain.sh.
byDep.libass: nix/packages/mk-pkg-libass/default.nix — `patch -p1` on the dependency's own ltmain.sh.
byDep.libogg: nix/packages/mk-pkg-libogg/default.nix — `patch -p1` on the dependency's own ltmain.sh.
byDep.libvorbis: nix/packages/mk-pkg-libvorbis/default.nix — `patch -p1` on the dependency's own ltmain.sh.
